info.name: Massage Reservation · Presentation & Extra Credits
info.description: Run in folder order. Steps 01–12 match the presentation checklist. Step 15 demonstrates extra credits with isolated fixtures and mock LINE only. Start npm run postman:demo first. Restart the demo before repeating extra credits. No Swagger or manual ID/token copying required. Steps 0, 13, 14 and 16 belong to slides.

exec: pm.test('MongoDB ID returned', () => pm.expect(result.data._id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/)); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', result.data._id); pm.test('Registration cannot grant admin', () => pm.expect(result.data.role).to.eql('user')); pm.test('Correct user', () => pm.expect(result.data.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userEmail')));

item.name: 15 · Extra credits — LINE, reviews and moderation

request.description: 15.01 Review fixture user log-in. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.

item.name: 15.02 Find completed and future fixture visits

request.description: 15.02 Find completed and future fixture visits. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.

exec: const completed = result.data.find(r => r.notes === 'Postman completed visit fixture'); const future = result.data.find(r => r.notes === 'Postman reminder fixture'); pm.test('Fresh eligible completed fixture exists', () => { pm.expect(completed).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(completed.canReview).to.eql(true); pm.expect(future).to.be.an('object'); }); if (completed && future) { pm.collectionVariables.set('completedId', completed._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('reviewShopId', completed.shop._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('reminderId', future._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('reminderAsOf', new Date(new Date(future.startAt).getTime() - 30*60000).toISOString()); }

request.description: 15.03 Check safe mock LINE mode. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.

exec: pm.test('Local mock login and dry-run delivery', () => { pm.expect(result.data.loginMode).to.eql('mock'); pm.expect(result.data.messagingMode).to.eql('dry-run'); });

request.description: 15.04 Start mock LINE linking. Expected HTTP 302. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.

exec: const callback = pm.response.headers.get('Location'); pm.test('Mock callback redirect', () => pm.expect(callback.startsWith('/api/v1/line/callback?code=mock-code&state=')).to.eql(true)); pm.collectionVariables.set('lineCallback', callback); pm.collectionVariables.set('lineState', decodeURIComponent(callback.match(/state=([^&]+)/)[1]));

request.description: 15.05 Finish mock LINE linking. Expected HTTP 302. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.
15.06 Confirm LINE linked. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.
15.07 Assign shop notification administrator. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.
15.08 Run post-visit prompt scheduler. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.

exec: pm.test('Review prompt delivered in dry-run mode', () => pm.expect(result.data.some(job => job.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('completedId') && job.kind === 'reviewPrompt' && job.status === 'sent')).to.eql(true));

request.description: 15.09 Inspect LINE review prompt. Expected HTTP 200. Run in order using the Local-Demo environment; credentials and IDs are captured automatically.

exec: pm.test('Prompt contains review link', () => pm.expect(result.data.some(m => m.text.includes('Please leave a review') && m.text.includes(pm.collectionVariables.get('completedId')))).to.eql(true));

exec: pm.test('Appointment reminder sent', () => pm.expect(result.data.some(r => r.reservation === pm.collectionVariables.get('reminderId') && r.status === 'sent')).to.eql(true));
